sentences.text: Adverts for tests and services relating to low testosterone are allowed but must be rooted in evidence, the regulator said Five adverts by online healthcare provider Voy have been banned by the watchdog for making misleading claims linked to low testosterone in men.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: The Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) said the adverts promoted Voy's at-home testosterone blood tests in three posters and two paid-for Facebook ads.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: It said they were misleading as they linked common symptoms such as irritability and fatigue to low testosterone.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: Voy said it had withdrawn the adverts while the investigation was under way and would not run them again.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: The NHS says that while testosterone levels in men fall as they age, this is "unlikely" to cause any problems in itself.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: It adds , external that while a testosterone deficiency in later life can sometimes be responsible for symptoms such as depression, loss of sex drive, erectile dysfunction, and other physical and emotional symptoms, they are often not linked.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: Voy is a company that sells products such as testosterone, menopause and weight loss treatments.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: Some of its testosterone test kit adverts drew a backlash online earlier this year when they appeared on the London Underground.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: Some described them as "ragebait" for using phrases such as "It's not him, it's his hormones" and "Men get hormonal too".
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: At the time Voy said it was trying to destigmatise conversations about men's health.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: Some of the adverts sparked discussion online after appearing at Tube stations The ASA's ruling, however, took issue with how some of the adverts "exaggerated the connection between several common symptoms, which can have many possible causes, and low testosterone".
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: The ASA gave examples such as low sex drive, low energy, loss of motivation and changes in mood.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: "While some symptoms may be more closely associated with the condition, others were much less specific and shouldn't have been presented as strong indicators of low testosterone in isolation," the watchdog said.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: It added that one of the Facebook adverts also included the claim that "low testosterone sneaks up on 1 in 4 men over 30".
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: The ASA said this was misleading and not supported by the evidence provided by Voy.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: Dr Earim Chaudry, chief medical officer for Voy, said: "Every patient decision at Voy is clinician-led and these campaigns were developed to align with UK advertising standards.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: We keep all our advertising under continual review to ensure it meets any updated guidance." Wednesday's ruling followed two others in August by the watchdog, which found misleading claims in adverts for testosterone testing services from online providers BioID Health and Numan Digital Healthcare.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: The rulings form part of a wider ASA investigation into adverts aimed at men concerned about their health.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: This has identified a "recurring theme of advertisers playing on insecurities around libido, erectile problems, testosterone and ageing", the regulator said.
sentences.article_title: Voy at-home test kit adverts banned over low testosterone claims

sentences.text: The watchdog said adverts for tests and services relating to low testosterone were allowed, but businesses needed to make sure the claims they made were accurate and supported by evidence.

sentences.text: A review into the health board found, in some areas, targets and money "have a greater priority... than the quality and safety of care" Wales' largest health board is still failing, with "fundamental weaknesses" in governance and management, a new report says.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: Betsi Cadwaladr University Health Board (BCUHB) has been in special measures for nine years in total, with the latest period starting in 2023.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: A review of its leadership published on Tuesday found, in some parts, targets and money "have a greater priority for senior management than the quality and safety of care".
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: Committed staff and ability to deliver some strong local services were highlighted.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: The health board apologised and said it now needed to concentrate on improving its leadership and allowing its staff to "flourish".
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: The review was commissioned by the Welsh government in the summer , after it gave BCUHB a "final chance" to improve.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: It concluded that senior leadership was "immature and ineffective", with weak senior management putting the quality of patient care at risk.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: The review did not suggest splitting up the health board, but Wales' health minister said the findings were "unacceptable" and BCUHB "does not function as a single coherent organisation".
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: The report said: "Many areas reported a culture where targets and financial matters have a greater priority for senior management than the quality and safety of care.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: "Fear of speaking up was described often... staff did not believe that raising a concern would result in corrective action.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: "Despite this, the panel witnessed many teams striving to deliver the very best care they could for patients." The reviewers also found a "toxic" culture at the health board where staff were afraid to speak out, and worried that no-one would listen if they did.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: The chair of BCUHB, Dyfed Edwards apologised for the health board's failings.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: "We haven't done things as we should," he said.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: "We have got things wrong.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: We need to take a step back from all the firefighting that has been going on and address key things.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: Her departure follows a string of other senior leaders who have left the organisation in recent months, including the chief operating officer and executive director of finance.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: The report also said that bureaucracy and slow decision-making led to a "loss of local ownership" and staff feeling frustrated.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: The reviewers wrote: "Staff and leaders described decisions moving through multiple layers of approval, authority becoming concentrated at senior levels and operational leaders lacking sufficient autonomy to act.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: "A phrase used in a focus group characterised the resulting complexity as 'Betsi spaghetti'." However, the review concluded the health board could still be improved without being broken up into smaller organisations - an option previously discussed by ministers.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: It said staff were "loyal and committed", and there were "strong local services" and "significant clinical expertise across north Wales".
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: Health Minister Mabon ap Gwynfor commissioned the review in June, and warned the health board that this was its "last chance" to improve Health Minister Mabon ap Gwynfor said: "these failings are utterly unacceptable".
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: "I also share the understandable frustrations of staff and patients alike in north Wales at the lack of progress in delivering and embedding improvements to services and standards of care," he said.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: "The report identifies that the health board does not currently demonstrate the organisational conditions required to deliver and sustain reliable improvement." But the health minister rejected calls for radical action or structural change to the NHS in north Wales.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: He said he would be making an order to appoint a new deputy chief executive and an independent board governance adviser.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: The post of vice chair - currently vacant - would also be filled.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: Prof Medwin Hughes, chair of the patients' watchdog Llais said: "There should be no more final chances - significant concerns have been expressed over many years by patients, and now is the time to really address these.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: "It's not good enough just to identify the issues.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: We now need there to be realistic targets and outcomes that deliver for patients and that deliver for citizens." Benjamin Hodge Mckenna MS, Reform UK Wales's health spokesperson, said BCUHB had been "plagued by mismanagement, poor performance and repeated failures".
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: "Senior leaders and government ministers cannot continue to preside over failure without facing consequences," he said.
sentences.article_title: Weak and immature management putting patients at risk at failing health board, review finds

sentences.text: Darren Millar MS, leader of the Welsh Conservatives, said: "These damning findings are sadly nothing new.

sentences.text: "Putting the health board in special measures was supposed to improve performance, yet things have got worse and people are dying as a result." Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates said the people of north Wales "deserve clear evidence that sustained improvement will be delivered".

sentences.text: Marwa was pregnant and new to the UK when her father died in Egypt We're all going to die - and whether we think about it consciously or not, we generally hope that it will be as smooth as possible for ourselves and our loved ones.

sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.text: So who needs the vaccine, what's in it and where can you get it for free?
sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.text: The vaccine offers protection against a dangerous strain of meningitis called meningitis B (MenB) that caused the outbreak in Kent.
sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.text: The vaccine does not contain any live bacteria and cannot cause meningitis.
sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.text: It is common to get some swelling, redness or tenderness where you have the injection.
sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.text: More serious side effects are rare.
sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.text: You do not need to be registered with a GP surgery to use the walk-in service.
sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.text: Find a participating pharmacy here , external .
sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.article_title: Starting uni? What to know about the free NHS meningitis B jab in England

sentences.text: Pupils will not be allowed access to their phones at all during the school day under stricter government guidance in England.

sentences.text: Statutory guidance came into force in June, making schools and trusts legally responsible for being phone-free throughout the day.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Ministers now say changes to that guidance will go beyond the current "no see, no hear" policies in place in some schools - where phones can remain in pupils' bags if they are not seen or heard - when it comes into force from September 2027.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: But head teachers' unions said schools would struggle to implement stricter new policies without additional funding from government.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Education Secretary Lucy Powell said the government's "clear message" to parents and pupils was that "school is for learning and friendship, not scrolling".
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Access to phones "risks pulling children away from their learning and from each other", the government said.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Schools will be able to decide how to follow the guidance.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Some schools have invested in sealed pouches or secure lockers.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Others collect phones at the start of the day, or have prohibited them from sites altogether.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Speaking to BBC Breakfast, Powell said such policies could achieve a "whole-school culture change" - and that was "what we want to see happening everywhere".
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Karl Harrison, head teacher at Burnage Academy for Boys in Manchester, told the programme the school had spent £20,000 to bring in a system of metal detectors and phone pouches to prevent pupils from accessing their phones.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: While some felt their freedom had gone, locking phones away had increased how much pupils socialised at school, he said.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: "People now can talk to each other, instead of scrolling on a device," he said.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: But he said the more robust measures recommended under the new guidance would "come at a cost".
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Pepe Di'Iasio, general secretary of the Association of School and College Leaders, said the latest guidance "does at least provide some clarity", but added that school leaders "cannot simply make mobile phones disappear".
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: "If all schools are going to be expected to have lockable pouches or other secure storage facilities for every pupil, the cost involved will be very significant indeed," he said.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: "This is not feasible unless the government puts in the funding required to meet these costs." Responding to questions about funding, Powell told BBC Breakfast that she wanted heads to have the autonomy to implement the policies that work best for their schools.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Dame Rachel de Souza, Children's Commissioner for England, said she welcomed strong action to stop phones distracting pupils and disrupting the school day.
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: Charlotte Ashton, co-founder of campaign group of Generation Focus, similarly welcomed the changes, saying "no see, no hear" policies were not working and pupils were still "TikToking in the toilets".
sentences.article_title: Phones to be banned from pupils' bags or pockets under stricter rules for schools in England

sentences.text: "Ultimately, we need to get to a point where it's not normal for every single child to have a personal internet-enabled device in their pockets with them 24/7," she said.

sentences.text: Too many university students can use AI to complete assessments without staff finding out, the higher education regulator in England has said.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: The Office for Students (OfS) said "a significant proportion" of assessments are unsupervised and many can be completed to a high standard with AI, sometimes in minutes.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: It said this posed a "significant risk" to their credibility, and closed-book and practical exams were the most effective forms of assessments.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Universities UK said many institutions had "made substantial changes" to make assessments "AI-proof".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Universities that do not meet OfS quality standards could soon be banned from charging increased tuition fees or have caps imposed on their student numbers, under proposals that are now being consulted on.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: The new research from the OfS and Advance HE, a charity that gives awards for teaching excellence, is based on the views of 244 higher education staff and 91 students from at least 127 universities.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: It said "a significant proportion of assessments" were in "unsupervised, non-controlled formats where AI can be accessed by students completing them".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "Many of these can be completed to a high standard using AI tools with limited engagement from students," it added.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: It also concluded it was "frequently possible" for students to use AI "in ways that cannot be reliably detected".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Unsupervised assessment can include coursework, but also remote online exams.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: They were rolled out widely during Covid, and research from Swansea University , external last year suggests 93 universities in the UK still use them in some form.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Josh Fleming, director of strategy and delivery at the OfS, said there were "fantastic" examples of universities seizing opportunities presented by AI, but there should be "far greater use of AI-free assessment".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "It also presents a generational risk to the system as it stands, threatening to undermine students' learning and institutions' ability to assess them," he said.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Kathryn Harrison-Graves, deputy chief executive at Advance HE, said students wanted "greater clarity about what is expected of them" but staff had "varying levels of confidence and support".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Some staff, meanwhile, were receiving lots of assignments that looked the same, and did not think their institution's assessments were "fit for purpose".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Other staff described a "polarised atmosphere" between students who used AI and other "conscientious objectors" who avoided it on environmental and other grounds.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: The research said AI literacy for students was important during and after university, and some institutions were clearly communicating to students where AI can and cannot be used in assessments.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: But it said there was "an urgent need" to ensure that remote or "non-secure" assessments "maintain their validity despite the availability of AI tools, meaning they effectively assess the knowledge and skills they are designed to measure".
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "If it becomes possible to complete an assessment using AI without the knowledge and skills being tested, the assessment should be replaced," it added.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Universities UK, which represents more than 140 institutions, said universities were "making significant progress" adapting to AI.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "There is further to go but many have made substantial changes to how they assess students.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: This includes more in-person exams, presentations, vivas, process-based assessment and assessments that integrate AI in a controlled way," a spokesperson said.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: "It's time to get rid of the outdated methods, that have been kept around in the name of tradition, and instead encourage the innovative practice we see across the sector, co-designed with students based on what they want from higher education," he said.
sentences.article_title: Students passing university assessments in minutes using AI, regulator warns

sentences.text: Action from "across society" is needed to help improve the educational outcomes of white working-class children, the co-chair of an independent inquiry looking into the issue has said.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: The inquiry's first report, published this summer , concluded that once-in-a-generation reforms were needed to fix a system "not serving the interests of white working-class children".
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: The next phase will focus on early years children and teenagers aged 14 to 19, aiming for a stronger start at primary school and improving older students' routes through education into successful careers.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: Education Secretary Lucy Powell said she was "backing" the inquiry to "get to the heart of the barriers holding children back".
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: Inquiry co-chair and former education secretary Baroness Morris said the next phase of the inquiry's work will consider "what needs to be done".
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: "This isn't just the responsibility of schools but calls for action from across society," she said.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: The Independent Inquiry into White Working Class Educational Outcomes , external was commissioned by the multi-academy trust Star Academies, and is supported by the Department for Education.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: It spoke to thousands of young people and their parents, as well as hundreds of teachers.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: Education data about white working class pupils was also analysed as part of the year-long review, looking at the 1.25 million young people in England who are white British and in receipt of free school meals.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: The inquiry found a growing belief among white working-class families that the current education system does not guarantee future success.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: In the summer, the inquiry also acknowledged that the true scale of white working-class disadvantage is "likely to be substantially larger", as the education data they looked at did not include families who were on low incomes but did not receive free school meals.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: Since then, all families receiving Universal Credit have become eligible for free school meals .
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: Under the new phase of the inquiry, practical recommendations for government, schools, colleges and other organisations working with white working-class communities will be developed.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: This action will include a research programme looking at the routes taken by teenagers aged 14 to 19, investigating how schools can work with communities to provide clearer pathways into further study and successful employment.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: The new phase of the inquiry will also look at how schools can ensure the transition from primary to secondary school builds strong foundations.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: "Right now, too many white working-class children are falling behind at every stage of their education," Powell said.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: The prime minister said he was "on a mission" to reduce the number of young people not in education, employment or training - known as "Neet".
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: Currently, nearly a million young people are classed as Neet.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: Former minister Alan Milburn's interim report , external found that children who are not school-ready at aged four or five are nearly three times as likely to be Neet by ages 16 to 17.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: A final report by Milburn is expected to set out his recommendations for tackling the issue in the coming weeks.
sentences.article_title: Society needs to act to help white working-class pupils, inquiry says

sentences.text: It is a question increasingly asked underneath social media videos, and often difficult to tell.

sentences.text: But there is a new trend when it comes to digital manipulation.

sentences.text: Across social media, AI-generated characters are appearing in videos that look remarkably similar to those posted by real people.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: From musicians to dancers and comedians, content creators are finding their performances cloned by these characters that are designed to look funny, realistic, or hypersexualised.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: Experts call the practice "reskinning" and say it is made possible by cheap, easy-to-use AI tools.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: People can discover their work has been copied by seeing a video of a character making the same joke or doing the same dance, even with the same background.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: Sometimes the AI version has millions more views than the original.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: Others appear to be experimenting with AI to make people laugh or simply for the attention that comes with going viral.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: "I've got so many messages from other artists and creators that have had the same thing happening to them," says Kjetil Krogstad, a Norwegian content creator known for videos showing him happily dancing in a suit while carrying a cup of tea.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: In March, his followers alerted him to the fact that one of his videos had been reskinned using an AI-generated bunny.
sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.article_title: The real people finding their work copied and stolen by AI characters

sentences.text: Australia's Chris Bowen sits at the top table at the summit surrounded by other delegates Countries have failed to reach a major new deal to tackle climate change after deep divisions over fossil fuels and money emerged at the UN COP31 talks in Turkey.

sentences.text: Negotiations were due to finish on Friday but ran late into Sunday in search of common ground, becoming the longest UN climate conference in history.

sentences.text: But the final deal proved unacceptable to the EU, Pacific island nations and others because it failed to directly mention fossil fuels, the main cause of global warming.
sentences.article_title: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal as deep divisions exposed

sentences.text: Meanwhile, many poorer countries objected to the absence of any clear financial commitments from richer nations to help them adapt to the impacts of rising temperatures.

sentences.article_title: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal as deep divisions exposed

sentences.text: He took aim at what he called "powerful fossil fuel interests" who he said were taking "a page from Big Tobacco's playbook: distorting the science, delaying policy, blocking action, and piling up huge profits while people everywhere pay the price".

sentences.text: After two weeks of negotiations, exhausted delegates were presented with a new, draft deal in the early hours of Sunday to try to break the deadlock.

sentences.article_title: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal as deep divisions exposed

sentences.text: The only indirect reference to coal, oil and gas was a nod to a deal agreed at COP28 in 2023 , when countries agreed to "transition away" from fossil fuels in energy systems.
sentences.article_title: Longest-ever UN climate talks end with no deal as deep divisions exposed

sentences.text: The EU's representative, Irish Minister Darragh O'Brien, made it clear that the EU "strongly" objected, saying that the "decisions go nowhere near the level of ambition needed to tackle climate change".

sentences.text: For a long time it seemed that Jensen Huang, the leather jacket-clad founder of Nvidia, dubbed the "Taylor Swift of tech", could do no wrong.

sentences.text: Then came allegations of two affairs - one with a businesswoman suspected of being a Chinese spy - that rocked the world of tech and the global stock market.

sentences.text: So what do we know about the man who is once again at the head of Nvidia, a linchpin in the US's race for technology leadership with China?

sentences.text: Huang may not be a household name on the same level as Elon Musk or Mark Zuckerberg.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: But his role in the tech industry, especially in relation to the explosion of artificial intelligence in the last three years, may prove more consequential.

sentences.text: Nvidia dominates the market for the microchips that are used to power the new technology.

sentences.text: Huang enjoyed access to the seats of political power on an unrivalled scale, being courted by both US President Donald Trump and China's President Xi Jinping.

sentences.text: His remarkable rise to the top of his profession saw him amass an estimated fortune of close to $200bn earlier this year, according to the Bloomberg Billionaires Index, though that has since dropped to around $105bn.

sentences.text: Despite always donning his trademark all-black outfits and taking a playful approach to investor presentations, Huang has worked for years to present himself as a family man, someone who exemplified the American Dream.

sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: The company became a key provider of the computer chips and circuits used for gaming before it expanded in a new direction.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: It now creates the key processing chips used to power the growing AI technology.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns after tech giant rocked by second affair allegation Who could replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia's chief executive?
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: Huang has hailed AI as a "new industrial revolution" that is on a par with the advent of electricity.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: Nvidia is the world's second most valuable company and its customers include the biggest firms on the planet, Google, Meta, Amazon, Microsoft, SpaceX, Tesla, OpenAI and Anthropic, all spending big on its products.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: So it is no surprise that at a recent AI summit at the White House, Huang was picked out from a group of 42 to flank the president, alongside Elon Musk, both men with whom Trump has famously close relationships.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: "Jensen Huang is a tech visionary of the likes of Steve Jobs," Stephen Witt, the author of Thinking Machine, a biography on Jensen Huang, told the BBC, referring to the late boss of Apple.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: He added that Huang was responsible for creating AI hardware as we know it today.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: He described him as a "demanding" boss, who "really pushes his people to the limit".
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: But while Huang is "very brilliant" and a "world-class computer scientist", there's also "a level of arrogance" and "a level of self-deception as well", he said.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: Huang had gone to great lengths to present himself as a family man, he added, something that was "very important to him".
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: First reports emerged on 29 October in the New York Times that Huang had conducted a relationship with Alice Huang, no relation.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: US officials allege the businesswoman associated with Singapore-based firm Megaspeed is a Chinese intelligence asset.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: Huang admitted to having been unfaithful to his wife and apologised for hurting their family.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: But the reporting of a second affair, with Kimberly Powell, vice president of healthcare who has worked at Nvidia for 18 years, prompted a board meeting, followed by an announcement that Huang was stepping down.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: He'd barely been gone, however, before a "Bring Jensen Back" campaign was launched, reportedly by current and former Nvidia employees, partners, shareholders and supporters.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: The man himself said he would be "honoured" to return, should the board ask him.
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: Although initially showing no interest in reinstating him, the board has now done just that, saying his return was "in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers".
sentences.article_title: The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang

sentences.text: I've just spent a week using Muse, Meta's AI agent that rolls out in the UK today.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Agents are systems that don't just respond to questions but can carry out tasks for you.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: With Muse, Meta gives the examples of "searching for a cheaper energy deal" or "sorting the school calendar." And it's true that it has helped me run my life - but it also challenged my personal privacy boundaries, and made me endure some cringeworthy interactions.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: How well Muse works really matters to Meta.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It has made a truly enormous bet on AI - of the $145bn (£111bn) it will spend this year much of it will be on building out the tech.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: For that to pay off we all need to start using it much more, and Meta hopes Muse will do for AI agents what WhatsApp did for messaging - that is, become the AI agent of choice for billions of people, putting Meta at the forefront of the AI revolution.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: But it's not just about what consumers think.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Regulators are keeping a careful eye on these emerging tools too.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "Agentic AI has significant potential to benefit people and businesses", the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) noted as Muse launched in the UK.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: But its chief executive, Paul Arnold, added it had been "clear with Meta about its responsibilities under data protection law prior to launch, particularly the requirement to ensure that users and the wider public can meaningfully understand and control how their personal data is used in the Muse product".
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Muse bills itself as a personal AI agent available to anyone aged 18 and over.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "It doesn't just answer questions, it actually goes out and does work for you," said David Singleton, Meta's VP of engineering on AI products.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "So it helps people stay on top of things," he added.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It won't book the holiday without your permission - but it can then make the purchase, if you let it.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: And the permission requests keep on coming.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Every time Muse wants to do something, send something or post something, you have to allow it.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It is reassuring to know that an AI agent isn't running amok in your name, even if it also gets a bit annoying, though you can give it more autonomy (and so get fewer messages) if you adjust the settings.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Muse can't access many apps at the moment but the fundamental ones are the most personal.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I found myself wincing as I hooked it up to one of my personal email accounts, my personal calendar and my personal phone messages.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I did not allow it any access to my BBC accounts.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It can't access WhatsApp except to set up a separate chat between it and the user, and while it found me some train tickets, it could not book them via the app which I use, and which is cheaper.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It ended up telling me to book them myself.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Amazon has blocked it from its marketplace, citing data security concerns but my agent didn't seem to know that, and spent a fruitless hour repeatedly telling me it was still waiting for the page to load in order to find me some shelves.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: A number of big UK firms are working with Meta though, including Marks & Spencer, Debenhams Group, Currys, Sainsbury's and Ocado.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: The ICO is urging consumers to be cautious with AI agents though: "consider the pros and cons," it said in a blog post to coincide with Muse's launch. , external "Agents can make mistakes.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Mistakes can be magnified if the agent is acting autonomously," it noted.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Meta is keen to emphasise how its agents can be personalised: "No two Muses are alike," , external it says in its press release.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I called my agent Linda - after the robot in the BBC TV series Ann Droid - but it can take any form you like.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I gave it a British, female accent from the myriad of choices available.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: As soon as an email came in, it would summarise it for me and suggest a reply.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Sometimes a long time before I was actually ready to respond.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Sometimes, if I hadn't interacted with it for a while, generally because I was busy, it would pop up with some random prompt like "did you know you can change my outfit?" I expect this is designed to drive engagement: Muse is only free to use until a certain point, and then subscriptions kick in.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It also wrote some embarrassing replies to messages on my behalf: in response to a question about whether I would like to go on an outing, for example, it included all the logistics I would need in order to get there, not realising that sometimes "yes, that sounds great" is enough.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: It seemed to want to have the last word quite a bit, occasionally getting stuck in a loop of "okay" and "thank you's".
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: Meta is relying on people choosing to trust it with even more of their personal data, despite a rather dubious track record historically with its social networks and a growing backlash against AI in general.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: I asked Linda - my new dedicated if occasionally clunky assistant - if it wanted to take people's jobs.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "I'm here to take the admin and the fiddly bits off your plate," it replied, leaving me to do the "thinking".
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: "Everything you do is stuff I would usually think about," I responded.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: And Linda is helping fuel that revolution, one calendar invite at a time.
sentences.article_title: Helpful but awkward: My week with Meta's Muse ahead of its UK launch

sentences.text: The US has said it intends to ban a Singaporean artificial intelligence (AI) company allegedly tied to the Nvidia scandal from doing business in America.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: The Department of Commerce announced it planned to add Megaspeed Ltd to a list of entities that are blacklisted from buying or selling goods in the US.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: The company is mainly a developer of data centres, but in recent weeks a former executive of Megaspeed was accused of working as a spy for China while having a romantic relationship with Nvidia head Jensen Huang.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: The relationship led to additional scrutiny by US officials and heightened concern that Megaspeed was funnelling Nvidia's advanced AI computer chips to China.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: When exactly the ban against Megaspeed will go into effect was not specified in the commerce department announcement.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: The BBC has asked the agency for comment, along with the White House and Megaspeed.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Megaspeed was not well known within the US until last month when media reports emerged that a former Megaspeed executive, Alice Huang, had an affair with Jensen Huang.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Alice Huang (no relation) was thought by US intelligence to be working as an asset for Beijing, creating national security concerns within the US.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: China has denied that she is a spy and warned the US not to use the scandal as a "pretext for imposing a technological blockade" on AI technology.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: On 12 November, Jensen Huang resigned after allegations he had had another affair, this one with a Nvidia employee.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: On Monday, Nvidia's board reinstated him after US President Donald Trump said he had "convinced" the company and "made the deal".
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: The commerce department has said it had been investigating Megaspeed for almost two years.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: The department said it had suspected the company was violating US export controls by helping to get Nvidia's chips into the hands of companies within China.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: China has been blocked from buying such technology since 2022.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Although based in Singapore, Megaspeed has significant business dealings in China.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Alibaba, for instance, the major Chinese online retailer, has been reported to be one if its largest customers.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Megaspeed was a known buyer of billions of dollars of Nvidia computer chips, including through its subsidiary Speedmatrix, which has also been added to the Commerce blacklist.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Nvidia's computer chips, originally designed for use in gaming consols, in recent years have become crucial to the continued growth of the AI industry.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Without enough supply or access to computer chips that are capable of processing the huge amount of data needed to make things like AI chatbots and models run, AI companies will not be able to meet or grow demand from people using AI tools.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: That has driven up the value of Nvidia on the stock market, as well as its influence in the AI industry and the White House.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Although tech stocks have in recent months been volatile and trending lower, when Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia because of his affairs, the company's stock fell by more than 30%.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Anxiety about the company's influence and ability to operate within the AI ecosystem without its famed executive appeared to take down shares of other tech companies, too.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Huang was reinstated on Monday to his position as head of Nvidia, a move that US President Donald Trump said he told the company's board to take .
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: The company's stock rallied on his reinstatement, as did several other tech stocks, but shares of Nvidia did not climb to where the company had been before being immersed in scandal.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: In the weeks ahead, Huang and the company he now runs again are facing multiple government agency investigations.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: Huang and the chief legal officer of Nvidia are set to appear next for a closed-door briefing with the House Foreign Affairs Committee.
sentences.article_title: US to blacklist Asian AI firm Megaspeed after Nvidia scandal

sentences.text: During the trial, the prosecution described Kurtaj as a "leading light" in the teen gang Lapsus$ A cyber criminal who hacked the maker of Grand Theft Auto has been released on licence on the same day as being sentenced to 7 years in prison.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: Multiple offender Arion Kurtaj, from Oxford, was released from custody with the judge warning him: "Don't let this happen again." The now 21-year-old hacked several companies and individuals, including GTA 6-maker Rockstar Games, whom he tried to extort after stealing clips of the unfinished game in 2022.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: Kurtaj had pleaded guilty last Monday at Woolwich Crown Court to the Rockstar hack and a handful of others which he carried out when he was 16 and 17 years old with the hacking gang Lapsus$.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: Kurtaj was originally sentenced to an indefinite stay in a secure hospital due to the severity of his autism.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: But, in an unusual move, he was subsequently deemed fit to stand trial and released to a normal prison in January.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: Now, he has been sentenced and released on the same day as the judge considered his hospital stay and remand in prison long enough.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: He has been given a Serious Crime Prevention Order which will last five years.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: It restricts his activity online including barring him from using Telegram and Discord.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: City of London Police said the case "highlights the dangers that young people can end up being drawn to online".
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: He hacked Rockstar games, Revolut and Uber while on bail and under police protection in a Travelodge in Bicester.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: He was there for protection from rival hackers who had threatened to attack him for his stolen stashes of Bitcoin.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: With his computer confiscated, Kurtaj hacked Rockstar using an Amazon Fire Stick plugged into his hotel room television along with a Bluetooth keyboard and mouse.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: He stole internal company data including 90 clips showing nearly 60 minutes of gameplay from the unfinished GTA 6, which had been shrouded in secrecy until its release last week.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: Rockstar Games said it cost the firm $5m (£3.8m) to recover from the hack, plus thousands of hours of staff time.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: The company also said the breach revealed for the first time that one of the playable characters in the game was a woman - a secret it was guarding closely for marketing purposes.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: When he was sentenced he stood and smiled.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: He had short hair and an unkempt beard and wore a suit and buttoned-up white shirt without a tie.
sentences.article_title: GTA 6 hacker released on licence with warning 'don't let this happen again'

sentences.text: Our Past is based in the building's basement and tells a weaving story of London through five different chapters Queen Victoria's mourning dress is among the objects on display A wide staircase to one side descends into what is called Past Time.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: Down here is what once was street level of Roman London, and curator Annette Day explains that "we felt that right in the guts, in the earth of the city, that was the place where we should explore London".
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: A weaving route beneath a seven-metre-high brick vaulted ceiling tells the capital's story.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: It starts with the city's creation by the Romans and moves through medieval times and London's place as the centre of the British Empire, before ending with the 2012 Olympic Games, a time when "London looked at itself and the world looked at London", says Day.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: Along the way are all manner of objects.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: There's Charles I's execution vest, Queen Victoria's mourning dress, a white 1960s Ford Cortina, an overstuffed taxidermy cat called Oliver and the shimmering Elizabethan jewellery of the Cheapside Hoard.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: Large illustrations are incorporated with historic objects to tell the story of the Great Fire of London Oliver the overstuffed taxidermy cat was once a Londoner's pet Galleries on either side also focus on specific moments.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: One features a recreated Roman room with amphoras - two-handled jars - a mosaic floor and the pieces of a magnificent wall painting found in Lime Street 20 years ago that hang on the wall.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: Another uses large comic illustrations based on new research to tell the story of the Great Fire of London in an attempt to reflect the subject's inclusion in Key Stage 1 of the national curriculum.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: Further along still, two other archways branch off to look at the lives of Londoners and the city's landscape, placing objects from across the ages alongside each other.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: The delicately feathered Dying Swan outfit worn by lauded Russian dancer Anna Pavlova stands beside the stage outfit of Edwardian music hall star Kitty Lord in one case, while another shows 2,000 years of London-made shoes.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: One case is even filled with toilets and chamber pots from medieval times to today.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: And to carry on that subject, on the far wall a small porthole frames a chunk of the eponymous Whitechapel fatberg , not far from the huge glass window that looks out on passing Thameslink trains (whose passengers apparently are yet to notice they are now being watched).
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: She sees the museum as a shared space for everyone, somewhere for Londoners and tourists alike to connect with people and stories from the past and now.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: "Think of this as like one of my favourite buses, the number 63 bus.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: You meet the world on it.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: And you meet the world in here." Most important of all, she says, is that the London Museum must always represent and reflect the city it is in.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: "The story of London is tough and joyful at the same time.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: That's why we use 'grit and glitter' as a tagline - it's both of those things, those dualities can exist.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: And we shouldn't be frightened of that history," she says.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: "We are making a museum and it will never stop, just like London never stops.
sentences.article_title: Fatbergs, feathers and flocks of sheep - inside the new London Museum

sentences.text: There's always cranes in London and there'll always be new things in London Museum." sentences.text: Recording of the well-loved radio soap could leave Birmingham for the first time in 75 years Audiences attending the final performances of The Archers' 75th anniversary roadshows are being urged to back a campaign to keep the long-running soap in Birmingham.
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: The broadcaster said it was having "constructive discussions with programme makers and local stakeholders," and remains committed to finding a long-term solution.
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: The BBC Radio 4 drama, which celebrated its 75th anniversary earlier this year, is set in the fictional West Midlands village of Ambridge.
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: It is believed to have been inspired by the village of Inkberrow in Worcestershire, with The Old Bull Inn being closely associated with the show's pub The Bull.
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: The corporation had initially pledged to build the show a new studio in the Tea Factory, its new hub in Digbeth, Birmingham.
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: However while the series production team will move there as planned, it was decided that the recording studio would no longer be built there .
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: A spokesperson for Equity said the cast was "unanimous in wanting to remain in the West Midlands".
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: Ben Norris, Equity representative for The Archers cast, said: "All of the rich tapestry of Ambridge life has been recorded in Birmingham since it was launched 75 years ago and we want it to remain there.
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: "If the BBC pulls us apart it threatens to undermine everything that makes The Archers so special to millions of people.
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: This is not a done deal and we're urging them to think again." The Archers was launched 75 years ago and has always been recorded in Birmingham Paul W Fleming, Equity general secretary, said the union feared programme makers were under pressure from the BBC to find "unrealistic and unworkable solutions".
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: He said: "The BBC is central to the cultural and economic life of our towns and cities, yet it plans to rip the heart out of the nation's best-loved radio drama." A BBC spokesperson said: "We fully understand the strength of feeling about The Archers' legacy and connection to the West Midlands.
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: "Whilst financial pressures on the BBC mean we are unable to build a new studio in The Tea Factory, we are having constructive discussions with programme makers and local stakeholders.
sentences.article_title: Archers fans urged to back fight to keep show in city

sentences.text: "Together, we are exploring alternative options in the area, but we have time on our side, as there will be no change until 2028 and we remain committed to finding a long-term solution." The live tour concludes in the West Midlands with events in Coventry on Wednesday and Wolverhampton on Thursday.
